# MapReduce-Reloaded: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/MapReduce-Reloaded` `ab65654` on 30 October 2026.

## What changed since the 23 October stamp

F1–F24 are marked done in `docs/paper-mapping.md`, including the §5 performance experiments. CircleCI is configured. The Python coordinator is under `python/mapreduce_reloaded/coordinator/`. A full Python worker was not found. S3 is VersityGW in the Compose `s3` profile, not MinIO. Compression flags accept none, zstd or snappy. `docs/report.md` and the benchmark harness exist.

## How the counts were taken

336 Go `func Test` functions and 487 Python `def test_` functions, by grep. That is not a passing-run total. Cluster chaos defaults to 5 runs (`make chaos`). The in-process default is 3 (`-chaos.runs`). 50 is the soak flag, not the default.

## Diagram

The case-study diagram is the Go cluster path. It omits the host client, the S3 profile, the Python coordinator and the benchmarks on purpose.

## Still not built

Dropping packets. A standby coordinator, skew handling and Parquet input remain stretch goals.

:::
